prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0092 代替テキストと触覚を分類したアクセシビリティ設定.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: original-accessibility-icon-detail. Image 3: original-haptics-icon-detail. Image 4: secondary-component-preview. Image 5: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Create ONE compact flat Japanese accessibility settings component, intended logical360x180, replacing the 390x280 roomy mock. White canvas,12px side padding,8px top/bottom, no overall card, no individual cards. Exactly FIVE text blocks, all Meiryo14px /24px line height, zero tracking. Exactly two BOLD headings and three REGULAR option labels. Do not shrink text for density. First heading: source circled universal accessibility person icon18x18 in slate, then8px gap and exact 代替テキスト BOLD14. Header24 high. Two px below, two compact32px option rows, labels indented to heading text: 投稿前に代替テキストを必須にする and 代替テキストの印を大きく表示, both14REGULAR, single line each. At right of each row a fully visible32x18 OFF switch: white interior, thin neutral slate capsule outline,14px gray thumb at LEFT, no clipping. Six px after second row put one fine neutral horizontal divider across336px. Eight px below, second24px heading with source18px phone-vibration icon: rounded smartphone frame with short top pill and two wavy side brackets;8px gap then exact 触覚 BOLD14. Two px below one32px option row exact 触覚による反応を無効にする REGULAR14, indented to heading text; identical outlined white OFF switch with gray LEFT thumb at right. Eight px bottom. Keep all three switches OFF, outline fully visible inside12px right padding. NO generic question mark or document icons, no filled gray tracks with white thumbs, no active green fill. Preserve source icon anatomy from supplied enlarged crops. No header/back/phone frame/status bar/footer/nav or invented copy. Tightly grouped compact two sections, legible ordinary UI scale and minimal outer whitespace.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: White flat surface, slate source-shaped icons, neutral outlined white OFF tracks and gray left thumbs. No green ON fill or mint panel. Preserve source-specific switch anatomy.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION, 2026-10-18: previous candidates were too big and too spacious. This overrides earlier source-spacing and presentation-enlargement instructions. Use compact ordinary UI proportions, content-driven control widths, restrained small radii, tight but readable padding, and little outer presentation whitespace. Preserve exact established Japanese font roles; do not shrink text to manufacture density. Preserve original icon geometry, strokes, states and artwork. Avoid stretching a small standalone utility control across an entire screen. Use the owner-corrected180x28 three-segment control as a density reference only, not a size to force onto unrelated components. Output image pixels are inspection resolution, never intended application CSS size.
reviewNotes: Five exact blocks, source icons and three outlined OFF left thumbs preserved. At360 intended width body appears about11 rather than14, headings about12 rather than14; compact panel needs text scale correction. No native/application acceptance.
